Lost in the Jungle#000.src: However... He also brought with him an odd purple gemstone. Our shaman saw it as a bad omen, but I was so caught up in the celebrations, I brushed it off.
Lost in the Jungle#000.dst: 可是，他还带回了一颗奇怪的紫色宝石。我们的萨满认为那是不祥之兆，但我当时沉浸在庆祝里，没当回事。

Lost in the Jungle#001.src: Hm, I just now am seeing a strange trail on the ground... it matches the color of the gemstone! It may take you to him, please, follow it!
Lost in the Jungle#001.dst: 嗯……我刚刚才看到地上有一道奇怪的痕迹……颜色跟那颗宝石一样！它也许能带你找到他，拜托，跟着它走！

Lost in the Jungle#002.src: You should talk to Aryn now...

Lost in the Jungle#003.src: Oh... My father sent you? Well, I am very impressed, Wynn warrior. You fight with the ferocity of our own!

Lost in the Jungle#004.src: But that is beside the point. You say you have destroyed the spirit, and it does not feel tainted any longer, so I will trust you.
Lost in the Jungle#004.dst: 不过这不是重点。你说你已经消灭了那个灵魂，而它也感觉不到邪气了，那我就相信你。

Lost in the Jungle#005.dst: 与 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Gracen 交谈

Lost in the Jungle#006.src: Excuse me, traveller... I am dreadfully sorry to ask this of you, but I need your help.
Lost in the Jungle#006.dst: 打扰一下，旅人……很抱歉要这样请求你，但我需要你的帮助。
Lost in the Jungle#006.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#007.src: You see, my son, Aryn. Very recently, he underwent a traditional coming-of-age ceremony from our tribe.
Lost in the Jungle#007.dst: 是这样的，我的儿子 Aryn。就在最近，他参加了我们部落传统的成年礼。
Lost in the Jungle#007.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#008.src: He was tasked to enter the dangerous {p}, just south of here, and brave the wilderness for three days. He returned a true man, successful.
Lost in the Jungle#008.dst: 他的任务是进入这里南边危险的 {p}，在荒野里撑过三天。他顺利回来，成了真正的男子汉。
Lost in the Jungle#008.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#010.src: Strange happenings began around the village. Aryn walked about at night, talking to someone, but no one else was there with him.
Lost in the Jungle#010.dst: 村子里开始发生怪事。Aryn 半夜到处走，跟某个人说话，可他身边根本没有别人。
Lost in the Jungle#010.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#011.src: Just last sunrise, he vanished entirely. We sent out a search for him, but even our hardiest warriors could not venture deep into the jungle.
Lost in the Jungle#011.dst: 就在昨天日出时，他彻底消失了。我们派人去找他，可就连我们最强悍的战士也没法深入丛林。
Lost in the Jungle#011.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#012.src: We returned empty-handed, having lost our newest tribesman. The village is in terrible spirits, and I feel as though I am responsible.
Lost in the Jungle#012.dst: 我们空手而归，失去了部落最年轻的成员。村子里士气低落，我觉得这都是我的责任。
Lost in the Jungle#012.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#013.src: You Wynn warriors, however... great stories are told of your exploits. Surely, you will be able to brave the jungle, yes?
Lost in the Jungle#013.dst: 不过你们 Wynn 的战士……你们的事迹被传得很神。你一定能闯进丛林，对吧？
Lost in the Jungle#013.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#014.src: I beg of you, please, find my son. I do not know quite where he is, but undoubtedly he has been taken quite a ways in...
Lost in the Jungle#014.dst: 我求求你，请找到我的儿子。我不太清楚他在哪里，但他肯定被带到丛林很深的地方去了……
Lost in the Jungle#014.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#017.src: P-please, I beg of you spirit, let me go free! The tribesmen must be so worried-
Lost in the Jungle#017.dst: 求、求求你，灵魂，放我走吧！部落的人一定急坏了——
Lost in the Jungle#017.speaker: Aryn

Lost in the Jungle#018.src: DO NOT RESIST, BOY! YOUR BODY IS MINE. I WAS TRAPPED IN THAT STONE FOR MILLENIA, AND NOW I AM FREE.
Lost in the Jungle#018.dst: 别反抗，小子！你的身体归我了。我被困在那块石头里上千年，现在我自由了。
Lost in the Jungle#018.speaker: Aryn?

Lost in the Jungle#019.src: Aha, I hear someone coming! Surely a tribesman here to rescue me!
Lost in the Jungle#019.dst: 啊哈，我听到有人来了！一定是部落的人来救我了！
Lost in the Jungle#019.speaker: Aryn

Lost in the Jungle#020.src: Oh! If so, the body of this warrior will be far better suited to my needs! Grant me your power, boy! I need to thrash them first to possess them!
Lost in the Jungle#020.dst: 噢！如果是这样，那个战士的身体会更合我的需要！把你的力量给我，小子！我得先把他们打趴下才能附身！
Lost in the Jungle#020.speaker: Aryn?

Lost in the Jungle#021.dst: 击败附身在 Aryn 身上的灵魂

Lost in the Jungle#022.src: Make sure Aryn is safe at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Lost in the Jungle#022.dst: 在 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 确认 Aryn 平安无事

Lost in the Jungle#023.src: Hahah, take that, evil wraith! You'll never match the power of our tribe-
Lost in the Jungle#023.dst: 哈哈，吃我一击吧，邪恶的幽灵！你永远比不上我们部落的力量——
Lost in the Jungle#023.speaker: Aryn

Lost in the Jungle#024.src: W-wait, you aren't part of our tribe! Who are you, why did you come here?
Lost in the Jungle#024.dst: 等、等等，你不是我们部落的人！你是谁，你为什么来这里？
Lost in the Jungle#024.speaker: Aryn

Lost in the Jungle#025.src: Oh... my father sent you? Well, I am very impressed, Wynn warrior. You fight with ferocity of our own!
Lost in the Jungle#025.dst: 噢……是我父亲派你来的？好吧，我非常佩服，Wynn 的战士。你打起来跟我们的人一样凶猛！
Lost in the Jungle#025.speaker: Aryn

Lost in the Jungle#026.src: I...can't say the same for myself. That spirit completely overtook me, I still can't move right now...
Lost in the Jungle#026.dst: 我……就没法这么说自己了。那个灵魂完全控制了我，我现在还动不了……
Lost in the Jungle#026.speaker: Aryn

Lost in the Jungle#027.src: For now, please. Take away this gemstone. It caused all this, I don't want to be near such a bad luck charm.
Lost in the Jungle#027.dst: 现在，拜托了。把这颗宝石拿走。都是它惹的祸，我不想靠近这种不祥之物。
Lost in the Jungle#027.speaker: Aryn

Lost in the Jungle#028.src: Tell the tribe that I will return on my own. I made it back once, I can do it again once I am prepared.
Lost in the Jungle#028.dst: 告诉部落的人，我会自己回去。我回去过一次，等我准备好了，就能再回去一次。
Lost in the Jungle#028.speaker: Aryn

Lost in the Jungle#029.src: Bring the Mysterious Gemstone to Gracen at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Lost in the Jungle#029.dst: 把神秘宝石带给 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的 Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#030.src: Oh my... Aryn was possessed by a spirit residing within the gemstone?
Lost in the Jungle#030.dst: 天哪……Aryn 被宝石里的灵魂附身了？
Lost in the Jungle#030.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#031.src: How shameful... Our shaman has never been wrong before, why did I disregard his warning...
Lost in the Jungle#031.dst: 真是惭愧……我们的萨满从来没错过，我为什么不听他的警告……
Lost in the Jungle#031.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#033.src: Looking at it now, this is actually quite a valuable stone. If crushed to dust, it can be used in special charms we make.
Lost in the Jungle#033.dst: 现在仔细看看，这其实是一颗相当贵重的宝石。磨成粉末的话，可以用在我们制作的特殊护符里。
Lost in the Jungle#033.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#034.src: Here, allow me to grind this down for you. You can keep the shards for whatever purposes you may find for them in the future.
Lost in the Jungle#034.dst: 来，让我帮你把它磨碎。你可以留着这些碎片，以后找到什么用处都行。
Lost in the Jungle#034.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#035.src: Our tribe, and especially myself... We thank you for your service. We shall consider you one of our own, from this day forward.
Lost in the Jungle#035.dst: 我们部落，尤其是我自己……感谢你的付出。从今天起，我们把你当作自己人。
Lost in the Jungle#035.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#036.src: In fact, if you'd like, you may even enter my house here whenever you'd like.
Lost in the Jungle#036.dst: 事实上，只要你愿意，随时都可以进我这里的房子。
Lost in the Jungle#036.speaker: Gracen
